items.title: Arnold Loyacano Interview, 1956-09-29
items.q: Ellie Coulon, he was in it.

ctx.x: Oh. Well, uh, I'll bet you those kids got in very little trouble compared to what they're doing.

Oh, well, there was practically no trouble. Once in a while, one out of a hundred might decide to crack a Chinaman's windowpane or something, you know, something like that. But, uh, as a rule, I'd say 99 percent of the kids were kids. They didn't, uh, well, they were taught better. There wasn't any reason to go around and throw rocks at the feet. Where'd you go to school, uh, um? I went to Jackson School. Did you? Toxico Magazine. Uh-huh. How far'd you go in school? I went to Top. And I went, uh, when I went…
What year was that? Do you remember?
